issues.description: A total-deadline expiry is not reported as a non-retryable timeout. If the remaining budget is already gone, callNegotiationModel returns errorCode timeout with retryable true, so a later attempt layer that trusts the flag will retry a call that has already used its deadline. If the deadline fires during retry backoff, withDeadline rejects and the catch returns kind aborted with detail 'request aborted during retry backoff', even when the caller signal did not abort. During send, the same deadline is classified as a timeout. The call does stop, so this does not push the request past the 275s watchdog, but the result contract disagrees with D09's timeout mapping.
issues.evidence: convex/agents/modelGateway.ts:2202 retryable: true on the budget-exhausted return; convex/agents/modelGateway.ts:2303-2315 catch of withDeadline(sleep(...), callSignal) returns kind 'aborted'. classifyError marks TimeoutError retryable false at convex/agents/modelGateway.ts:1112-1126.
issues.suggested_fix: Return retryable false and errorCode timeout when remainingBudgetMs <= 0. In the backoff catch, if params.signal is not aborted, return kind error / errorCode timeout instead of aborted.

issues.description: The gateway now follows canon D09, and runtime R11 plus §10.11 are stale. R11 still assigns 429, 529, 5xx, 408, 409, connection errors, and pre-stream timeout to SDK maxRetries 1, and §10.11 still publishes CALL_DEADLINE_MS 448000, which is after WATCHDOG_FIRST_MS 275000. §10.10.2 also retries output.truncated as a new attempt row. Copying that into decideRetry would truncate twice, because callNegotiationModel already retries max_tokens once and returns retryable false. The code should not be changed back; the design text should.
issues.evidence: convex/agents/modelGateway.ts:41 SDK_MAX_RETRIES = 0; :61 CALL_DEADLINE_MS 230000; :65 WATCHDOG_FIRST_MS 275000. docs/design-work/final-v2/10-agent-runtime.md R11 and 10-agent-runtime-part4.md §10.10.1 and the CALL_DEADLINE formula at 448000.
issues.suggested_fix: Amend R11, §10.10, and §10.11: SDK retries stay 0, the only gateway transport retry is 429 and connection errors, truncation retry stays inside callNegotiationModel and is not repeated by decideRetry, and the total deadline must fall before the first watchdog (230s < 275s), not only before WATCHDOG_FINAL.

issues.description: Cooldown exceptions no longer share one expiry, but the generator only spreads them across 1–7 days from the day it runs. Eight packages expire on 2026-10-25, the day after this review, including vite, postcss, eslint-config-next, and the darwin-arm64 rolldown binding. policy:check will start failing then, earlier than the old shared 2026-10-31 date.
issues.evidence: scripts/check-dependency-policy.mjs expiresFor uses (1 + charCode sum % 7) days. scripts/cooldown-exceptions.json entries for vite@8.3.5, postcss@8.5.31, eslint-config-next@16.4.3, @rolldown/binding-darwin-arm64@1.2.15, @rolldown/binding-linux-arm-gnueabihf@1.2.15, @tanstack/query-core@5.104.5, @typescript-eslint/parser@8.72.0, and baseline-browser-mapping@2.11.31 all expire 2026-10-25.
issues.suggested_fix: Keep distinct per-package dates, but set the minimum several days out so a regenerate does not make policy:check fail the next day. The --generate instruction in the README and in the policy error is already in place.

issues.description: The shared scenario-key constant is the right fix, but the literal scope_change is defined in the engine. §11.0 says the engine knows no scenario, and the next comment in plugin.ts says the engine never depends on a concrete scenario. The pattern belongs in the engine; the literal belongs with the scenario package.
issues.evidence: core/engine/plugin.ts:1-5 exports SCENARIO_KEY = "scope_change" and then says the engine never depends on a concrete scenario. docs/design-work/final-v2/11-architecture.md §11.0 item 3.
issues.suggested_fix: Move the literal into core/scenarios/scope-change and keep only SCENARIO_KEY_PATTERN in the engine. The plugin, fixture, and health.ping can keep importing that one constant.

strengths: Truncation retries once inside the same call, records the first attempt's usage and requestId before the second send, and does not retry refusal or context overflow.

SDK retries are forced off. One gateway retry covers only 429 and connection errors, and the 230s total deadline is a single AbortSignal budget that module load requires to fire before the 275s watchdog.
drainDue does not run future jobs, and the example test locks that in. The scenario runtime key is scope_change everywhere it is a key, with the directory left as scope-change.
Public templates reject free-string slots, cents and dates no longer echo rejected values, and catalog titles are bounded and wrapped as untrusted data.
The battery report is not ok until cases are actually executed, the self-comparing arithmetic assertions are gone, and the test helper is out of the Convex function graph.

lint, typecheck, and pnpm test passed here: 254 passed and 220 todo in the main suite, 9 script tests, 11 harness tests, and 14 deliberate boundary violations rejected. The previously flaky r02 timeout assertion passed three times under a frozen clock.
